clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there's a part of the brain called the hippocampus, and it is measurably bigger in wealthy people than in everyone else.

In testing across wealthy families, it's larger in the children too - not because of race, Trudeau says, but because of how much money is actually flowing through that household.

He says the same part of the brain goes small in people who try to visualize their goals and get nowhere. Same technique, different hardware.

Have you ever done everything right and still felt like nothing was landing?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #mindset #lawofattraction #wealthmindset #brain
